items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: but I did hear him play he played opposite us we played for the dancing and he played for the girls to sing

ctx.x: did you ever remember Tony Jackson hearing him here
Tony Jackson was at the Deluxe when we first went up there they had four girl entertainers Cora Green Florence Mills Mamie Mamie somebody and a girl they called Twinkle
